scripts.deploy: cd ./frontend && pnpm build && cd ../backend && wrangler deploy
scripts.wasm-build: cd rust-rasterizer && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg-web --release && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('pkg-web/package.json'));p.name='larry-rasterizer-web';fs.writeFileSync('pkg-web/package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n')"
